pending.chat: Requires the conversation model and the MCP server conversational agent. Strix built this screen on data this platform does not produce yet, and a chat form with no agent behind it would be an empty box.
pending.domains: Requires the domain model with ownership verification over DNS TXT or an HTTP file. Without that verification nothing can be scanned from the outside, so the table will be built together with the endpoint, not before it.
pending.assetDiscovery: Requires the discovery model and its daily quota. Discovery builds on verified domains, so it cannot exist before them.
pending.supplyChain: Requires Strix to expose the dependency SBOM. The engine does not publish it today, so there is nothing to show even when the plan covers it.
pending.containers: Requires the container inventory and access to the host runtime, which is not implemented yet.
pending.networks: Requires the network scanner and the subdomain model. Both arrive with Phase 6.
pending.integrations: Requires storage for MCP connections and the Jira and Linear OAuth flows, which is Phase 5 task 3.4.
pending.apiAccess: Requires the 46-scope matrix and hashed token storage, which is Phase 5 task 3.4. Building the form now would leave a button that saves nothing.
pending.settings: Requires the organization rename and delete endpoints, which do not exist yet. The view will be built complete once those operations can be confirmed.
